progress_summary: The v1.9 hardening manifest passed pre-deploy and live replay in both staging and production at exact runtime SHA 244bf13e9b4e0abbca5a3d8cb8dfdb811d0b1248. Forty-five MCP tests, six retention tests, limiter configuration, distinct signing-key wiring, Origin controls, request-size and batch limits, forged-token rejection, and signed-session checkpoint roundtrips are green. The staging rail also demonstrated its automatic rollback on a bounded convergence miss before the successful retry. Production activation and verification passed without rollback.
